title: {{NAME}} and the Super Dino Championship
moral: True champions cheer for everyone, not just themselves.

pages.content: {{NAME}} was a superhero who loved soccer. Today was the big championship day. The stadium was huge and full of cheering fans. {{NAME}} ran onto the bright green pitch. A friendly blue dinosaur was on his team. They wore matching green jerseys. But the other team looked very big and fast.
